characters.name: Prinsen
characters.description: The prince is a young and noble figure, slender and taller than average. He has a fair complexion that is now pale due to hardship. His hair is dark and slightly disheveled from his recent adventures. His clothing is regal but weathered, consisting of a tattered cloak and worn boots. He stands at the edge of a castle, bracing against a powerful north wind that tugs at his garments.

characters.name: Dronningen
characters.description: The queen is an elegant woman with a poised demeanor. She has gentle features, with eyes filled with warmth and recognition as she sees the ring on the prince's finger. Her attire is regal, adorned with intricate patterns, and her long hair is held in place by a simple yet elegant crown.

characters.name: Konen
characters.description: The woman is middle-aged, short and stout, with a determined expression. She is dressed in rural garb, a simple dress with an apron. She leads a cow by its rope and holds a hen under her arm, walking towards the town with an air of resolve in her countenance.

characters.name: Konen i Fjäret
characters.description: A comical figure covered entirely in feathers, making her resemble a bird more than a human. Her eyes are wide with confusion, and her mouth slightly ajar as if in disbelief. Her attire is obscured by the thick layer of feathers, which cling awkwardly to her small frame.

characters.name: Manden der snyder
characters.description: The man is of average height with a cunning expression on his weathered face. His hair is unkempt, and he wears rustic clothing suited for travel. He is busy tying horsehair to a birch tree, glancing mischievously at another man whom he is tricking into looking at the sky.

characters.name: Konen paa Marken
characters.description: A perplexed woman of modest stature, dressed in simple, weathered clothing. She is standing on a barren field, visibly bewildered as she sprinkles salt on the earth, hoping for crops to grow. Her hair is tied back in a loose bun, and she holds the salt shaker in one hand, gazing questioningly at the land.

characters.name: Skytteren
characters.description: A rugged and experienced hunter, somewhat middle-aged, with a focused and slightly amused expression. He wears traditional hunting attire, complete with a hat and boots, and holds a gun in a relaxed manner. He stands amid a forest setting, attentively listening to the pleading bird mother.

characters.name: Myrsnipen
characters.description: A small, delicate bird with a worried expression. Her plumage is mottled in browns and whites, blending seamlessly into the forest environment. Her eyes are large and earnest as she pleads with the hunter to spare her children.
